text: Workplace trust is a condition for technological change to empower employees: a one percentage point rise in technological change is associated with a 0.23 percentage point rise in perceived empowerment where trust exists, against only 0.10 percentage points where it does not.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and the Future of Work (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900880

isBasedOn.name: Quantum Economy and the Future of Work

abstract: A one percentage point rise in technological change is associated with a 0.23 percentage point rise in perceived empowerment in workplaces with trust, compared to only a 0.10 percentage point rise in workplaces without much trust.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: workplaces with and without established trust
